text:
jordan: Escalation — customer on Next 13 Edge (pnpm v8) can't bundle our Node/TS SDK for edge runtime. Build succeeds locally but edge deploy fails with unresolved subpath and missing types. Repro steps attached.

dev-bot: New escalation created: SEV-3 -> eng-packaging. Tagging @tanya.

kevin-cust: Repro (minimal):
1) pnpm init && pnpm add @redwood/inference@^2.4.0
2) Next 13 app with route under /app/edge/route.tsx, runtime: 'edge'
3) deploy fails: see error below.

kevin-cust: Error log:
```
Error: Cannot resolve package '@redwood/inference' from /vercel/path/app/edge/route.tsx
while resolving import "@redwood/inference"
caused by: Package subpath './dist/index.js' is not defined by 'exports' in /workspace/node_modules/@redwood/inference/package.json
```

kevin-cust: Also TS complaint in local build: "Could not find a declaration file for module '@redwood/inference'" even though we ship types.

jordan: Customer tried forcing resolution with `resolve.alias` and bundler externals, didn't help. They said rolling back to an older pinned version (2.2.1) worked.

tanya: Thanks. Two likely causes: (1) our package.json exports map doesn't include an edge-friendly subpath for bundlers that rewrite imports, (2) types field path might be mismatched after our recent rollup->tsup change. Can you paste package.json from node_modules/@redwood/inference and the exact import statement?

kevin-cust: Import is just `import { createClient } from '@redwood/inference'`. package.json (from node_modules):
```json
{
  "name": "@redwood/inference",
  "version": "2.4.0",
  "main": "dist/cjs/index.js",
  "module": "dist/esm/index.js",
  "types": "dist/types/index.d.ts",
  "exports": {
    ".": {
      "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js",
      "import": "./dist/esm/index.js"
    },
    "./package.json": "./package.json"
  }
}
```

kevin-cust: Note: dist/esm/index.js exists, but Vercel/Edge rewrite complains about attempting to resolve `./dist/index.js` (no ext) — looks like a subpath rewrite from some bundler plugin.

tanya: Hmm. Two quick checks: 1) does pnpm create a hoisted symlink that changes resolution? 2) some bundlers try to resolve `./dist/index.js` when they encounter a deep import. We didn't include a fallback "\." : "./dist/index.js" in exports; older versions might have had a different layout so pinning worked.

tanya: Temporary customer workaround: in next.config.js set `experimental: { esmExternals: 'loose' }` or add a webpack alias to point `@redwood/inference` -> require.resolve('@redwood/inference/dist/esm/index.js') — not ideal but unblocks deploy.

jordan: Can we publish a patch that adds a fallback export path and verifies `types` path? If so the customer can upgrade to patch and avoid the workaround.

tanya: Yes — plan: patch 2.4.1 to add additional exports entries for common rewrite targets and ensure `types` points at `./dist/types/index.d.ts`. I'll also add a test that installs with pnpm + next edge.

tanya: Proposed package.json change (diff):
```diff
 "exports": {
-  ".": {
-    "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js",
-    "import": "./dist/esm/index.js"
-  },
+  ".": {
+    "default": "./dist/esm/index.js",
+    "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js",
+    "import": "./dist/esm/index.js"
+  },
+  "./dist/index.js": "./dist/esm/index.js",
+  "./dist": "./dist/esm"
 }
```

tanya: That should cover common bundler rewrites. Also adding a top-level `exports: {"./package.json": "./package.json"}` retained. I'll run CI for pnpm+next.

kevin-cust: Trying the `esmExternals: 'loose'` workaround now, looks promising — build moved past the previous error. Will verify runtime behavior.

jordan: I'll notify the customer and keep this thread updated. @tanya please link the GH issue/PR when you open it so we can track. :thumbsup:

tanya: Opening PR now, will include release notes and a changelog entry for packaging fix. Assigning to eng-packaging review.

kevin-cust: Confirmed — edge deploy succeeded with the loose setting. Thanks for the quick triage.

jordan: Closing loop after patch release.
